ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point D is a point on side AC of $\triangle ABC$. Points B and C are symmetric with respect to DE. If $AC=6$ and $AD=2$, what is the length of segment BD?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \quad Since $AC=6$ and $AD=2$, \\
$\therefore CD=AC-AD=6-2=4$, \\
Since $B$ and $C$ are symmetrical about $DE$, \\
$\therefore DB=DC=\boxed{4}$.
